This 2024 Subaru Legacy Premium pulls its weight on any road thanks to Subaru's full-time all-wheel drive and a 2.5L four-cylinder engine paired with a Lineartronic CVT. You get confident handling in rain, snow, and everything in between, and the fuel economy holds up well at 27 city and 35 highway MPG. At just over 60,000 miles, this one is well into its stride but has plenty of life left. The Ice Silver Metallic finish looks sharp, and the black interior keeps things clean and easy to maintain.

Inside, this Legacy is comfortable and well-equipped. The heated front seats are a welcome touch on cold New England mornings, and the dual-zone automatic climate control lets driver and passenger set their own temperature. The 11.6-inch Subaru STARLINK Multimedia Plus system handles your audio and connectivity, and SiriusXM with 360L is built right in. The power driver seat, leather-wrapped steering wheel with audio controls, and telescoping tilt column make it easy to dial in your ideal driving position. A rear camera, auto high-beam headlights, and a full suite of airbags round out the safety side of things.

The split-folding rear seat adds flexibility when you need extra cargo space, and thoughtful touches like the front center armrest with storage, overhead console, rear seat center armrest, and door bins in both front doors make everyday errands a little more organized. STARLINK Safety Plus comes with a three-year free trial, which covers emergency communication features that can make a real difference if you ever need them. The 17-inch black machined aluminum-alloy wheels give this sedan a polished look that punches above the price point.

If this Legacy sounds like a good fit, give us a call at 978-797-1818 and our team will be happy to answer any questions or get you set up for a test drive here at AutoFair Subaru.

  • Unresponsive driver assistant - a reaction to inaction. Maybe you fell asleep. Maybe you lost consciousness. No matter how it happens, Unresponsive driver assistant works to help lessen the danger when it does. It detects prolonged driver unresponsiveness, automatically bringing the vehicle to a stop and turning on the hazard lights. If equipped, emergency services will also be contacted. Unresponsive driver assistant is safety that never sleeps.
Safety and Security
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
